directory_policies.notes.7: English validity: The SCS page prints September 1, 2024 while the program requires tests within the last two years. These are not silently reconciled for a Fall 2027 application; current-cycle confirmation is still required.

fact_summary: The SCS page lists a specific older cutoff and separate successful-applicant ranges. Its cutoff must be reconciled with the MCDS rolling two-year requirement before automatic validity decisions.
